name: flagman
description: A live map of a big task: items with stages and statuses, updated by the fm command and shown in a local web page.

tasks_dir.title: Tasks folder
tasks_dir.description: Where task folders live; empty = found from the current folder

lang.title: Graph language
lang.description: Language of new graphs: en or ru; empty = en

watch_files.title: Watched files
watch_files.description: Comma-separated file names or globs (e.g. PROGRESS.md,*.status.md) whose edits remind a session to update the graph

auto_graph.title: Auto graph
auto_graph.description: When a task is split into many items and has no graph: ask = offer one, on = create it, off = only on request

auto_graph_min.title: Auto graph threshold
auto_graph_min.description: How many items in a plan or todo list make a task big enough for a graph
